billing.description: Issues related to charges, payments, invoices, and subscriptions fees.
belongs: Failed payment where money was still deducted

refund.description: Requests or questions about getting money back for a purchase.
does_not_belong: Billing disputes about incorrect charges (-> billing)

shipping.description: Issues related to delivery, tracking, and order logistics.
does_not_belong: Product defects discovered after opening (-> technical)

account.description: Issues with account access, profile, settings, and subscriptions (non-security).

security.description: Issues involving unauthorized access, fraud, account compromise, or suspicious activity.

technical.description: Software bugs, app crashes, feature malfunctions, and product defects.

sales.description: Pre-purchase questions, pricing, upgrades, and partnership enquiries.

general.description: Compliments, feedback, vague queries, and anything that doesn't clearly fit another category.

out_of_scope.description: Completely unrelated topics, gibberish, adversarial input, or content with no support intent.

P0.label: Critical
P0.description: Active security compromise, major system-wide impact, or imminent high-risk event.
examples: Someone has taken over my account right now
Active fraud on my payment card

P1.label: Urgent
P1.description: Serious financial problem, significant account damage, or high customer impact requiring fast action.
examples: Cannot access account and lost important data
Refund of large amount stuck for weeks

P2.label: Normal
P2.description: Standard support issue — refund, delivery, technical problem — with moderate customer impact.

P3.label: Low
P3.description: General questions, information requests, and non-urgent enquiries.

priority_rules.note: Priority depends on CONTEXT and SEVERITY, not category alone.

force_human_when: Message is ambiguous with multiple conflicting intents
Category is security AND priority is P0 or P1
LLM output failed schema validation after retries
Required information is missing to take action
